title: Can You Eat Your Favorite Candy on Your Favorite Day?
goal: Determine whether a favorite candy type can be eaten on a chosen day under daily limits.
strategy: Prefix sums locate each type in the required eating order. By day d inclusive, total consumption ranges from d+1 to (d+1)*cap; test overlap with the favorite type positions.
